request: Rank the 4 best Ford Mustang generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: UNVEILING THE BEST FORD MUSTANG GENERATIONS
close_narration: Which classic Mustang version would rev your engine? The '65 original, '79 Fox Body, or '05 retro revival?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: Fifth Generation
entries.label: RETRO FUTURE
entries.one_line_fact: Let's dive into Mustang history, starting at number four with the Fifth Generation. Introduced in 2005, this retro masterpiece brought back classic lines with modern flair. At $19,995, it offered a tempting 300 horsepower package, blending past and present beautifully.
entries.ranking_case: The S197 reinvigorated the Mustang with a retro aesthetic and modern performance, keeping enthusiasts satisfied.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $13K.

entries.label: FOX BODY REVIVAL
entries.one_line_fact: Then we have the Third Generation, the Fox Body Revival. Rolling out in 1979, it brought back performance excitement for just $4,187. With a distinctive boxy shape and quad lights, it rejuvenated the Mustang spirit with 225 horsepower.

entries.name: First Generation
entries.label: ICONIC BEGINNING
entries.one_line_fact: Now, the iconic First Generation. Launched in 1965, this starting point had a punchy 271 horsepower engine and a price tag of $2,368. While it lacked modern tech, its timeless design features like round headlights and chrome bumpers defined the Mustang’s enduring charm.
entries.ranking_case: The first-gen Mustang is a timeless American icon beloved for its classic design and initial market impact.

research_sources.title: 1965 Ford Mustang Is Still Gaining Speed

entries.name: Sixth Generation
entries.label: GLOBAL ICON
entries.one_line_fact: And our top spot goes to the Sixth Generation—a true global icon. From 2015, it delivered a 435 horsepower punch with independent suspension at $23,900, modernizing the Mustang without losing its soul. Its sleek shape and tri-bar lights make it unmistakably Mustang.
entries.ranking_case: With its independent rear suspension and global reach, the S550 advanced the Mustang into a new era.
